title: Pão de Queijo
description: A traditional Brazilian cheese bread recipe, flaky on the outside and gooey on the inside. Pão de Queijo is a staple in Brazilian cuisine.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, combine warm milk and yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
2. In a large mixing bowl, combine cornstarch, salt, and 1 cup of the Brazilian cheese. Mix well.
3. Add the yeast mixture to the cheese mixture and mix until a dough forms.
4. Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
5. Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
6. Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
7. Coat each disk with cornstarch, shaking off excess.
8. Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
9. Cook the pão de queijo for 4-5 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
10. Serve hot with additional shredded cheese if desired.
